title: Geopolitical Daily
preheader: Plus Trump tells Zelensky to stop hitting Russian refineries as diesel prices spike.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Monday, September 14, 2026 — the 3 stories that matter most today, plus 8 quick updates from around the world.

stories.story_title: Oil Jumps to $108 as Middle East Attacks Multiply
stories.why_important: Brent crude jumped more than $3 in a day after new strikes hit Saudi Arabia and a ship in the Strait of Hormuz. That is the fastest oil spike in months. Higher oil means higher prices everywhere, from gas pumps to shipping costs, and shows how fast Gulf tensions can hit ordinary wallets worldwide.
stories.what_overlooked: Coverage focuses on prices but underplays that Gulf states have now postponed talks with Iran entirely, removing a key off-ramp.
stories.prediction: Watch whether Brent crude breaks $110 if attacks on Gulf shipping or Saudi facilities continue this week.

stories.story_title: Trump Tells Zelensky to Stop Hitting Russian Oil Refineries
stories.why_important: Trump publicly asked Ukraine to stop striking Russian refineries, blaming the attacks for a global diesel shortage. This is a real shift: for months the US quietly tolerated Ukraine's strikes on Russian energy sites.
stories.what_overlooked: Trump's framing skips that Russia itself banned diesel exports in July, and that Moscow's own claims about the Zaporizhzhia plant are unverified.
stories.prediction: Watch whether Ukraine pauses refinery strikes or defies Trump's request in the next 72 hours.

stories.story_title: Indonesian Ferry Capsizes With 129 People Still Missing
stories.why_important: A ferry carrying over 240 people sank in rough seas off Java. Six are dead and 129 remain missing despite a 600-person rescue effort.
stories.what_overlooked: Little scrutiny yet of why the ship carried far more passengers than its listed capacity of 243.
stories.prediction: Expect an updated death toll as search crews continue through midweek in worsening seas.

quick_hits.text: Sweden's left-wing bloc holds a razor-thin lead over the right; final results are due Wednesday.
Turkish police detained dozens, with some reports citing up to 162 people, in raids on LGBTQ+ groups.
Trump said a $5,000 payout to every US adult is 'easy' to afford if Republicans win the midterms.
Trump downplayed a report that China gave Iran satellite images used before a deadly Jordan base attack.
A Russian drone hit a train near the Ukraine-Poland border minutes after Boris Johnson's delegation left.
Israeli strikes killed at least 10 Palestinians in Gaza over 48 hours, including a pregnant woman.
Trump reaffirmed support for a united Ireland, drawing sharp pushback from Britain's government.
Israel's culture minister called for stripping citizenship from the directors of Gaza documentary NAZA.
